claims.statement: Replaying held allocations without correcting closed pickup slots re-booked orders into expired slots; the 30-minute slot window had already closed by the time of replay execution
claims.limitation: Confirms that slot window closure is a critical constraint; replay requires the slots to be open or extended first

claims.statement: Extending the pickup slot closure window from 30 minutes to a duration accommodating the 47-minute median carrier confirmation latency will allow the held orders to receive carrier confirmation within their (extended) slot window when replayed
claims.limitation: Assumes the carrier system continues to operate at 47-minute latency; if the carrier system recovers (confirmation latency improves), the extended slots provide additional margin but are not strictly necessary

dispositions.rationale: hyp_005 proposed re-booking as a workaround; obs_010 shows re-booking alone is insufficient without slot correction. Refined to acknowledge slot-dependent nature of the solution.

next_action.rationale: The replay action failed because the 30-minute pickup slots had closed before re-booking execution. The root cause (carrier confirmation latency at 47 minutes) requires the slot window to remain open for confirmation to complete. Applying a slot correction will extend the closure window beyond the median carrier latency, allowing held orders to be re-booked and receive confirmation within the extended window. This is a reversible action within authority and directly enables the replay mitigation to succeed.
